A chunked request body is buffered without a limit

items.title: Clean install from the README
items.why: ./install.sh worked (uv tool path, no network needed beyond build); sidedoor on PATH after adding ~/.local/bin

items.title: The README's quick-start commands work as written (install, run, backup)

items.title: Listens on localhost unless configured
items.why: trial broker and target bind 127.0.0.1 on random ports; no long-running service

items.title: Starts empty; demo data only on an explicit flag or command
items.why: fresh init has 0 profiles, 0 trials; demo only via sidedoor demo

items.title: First-run admin setup, no default password
items.why: no accounts or login; owner is the OS user who ran init
